ETHNICITY_BLOCK: Modern Chinese Han ethnicity, contemporary mainland Chinese urban working-class facial structure. Standard epicanthic-fold East Asian eye shape with monolid-to-low-fold upper lid crease, dark brown irises, straight dark eyebrows, broad flat cheekbones, moderately broad nose with rounded tip, naturally pale-to-medium warm skin tone with sun-weathering and minor outdoor grime, faint under-eye bags and nasolabial lines consistent with a man in his late thirties who does physical work and drives for a living. NOT a Eurasian mixed-look male model, NOT a Northern Chinese/Pinyin border-region face, NOT a Southern Cantonese/Chaozhou vendor stereotype. MUST read as an ordinary contemporary mainland Chinese man, mid-30s to early 40s.
COLOR_PALETTE: Muted everyday urban palette — charcoal grey, faded indigo denim, dusty olive work jacket, off-white and heather grey cotton tee, worn brown leather belt, scuffed tan work boots, aged brass hardware on the key ring, mirrored sun visor on the cap. ALL materials laundered but lived-in, dust on the shoulders and cuffs, NOT clean NOT new NOT luxury-brand NOT fashion-editorial.
